caption:
A reminder from the Qur'an: with hardship comes ease.

Surah Ash-Sharh (94:5). Swipe through for the Arabic, then English, Mandarin, Korean and Japanese renderings.

Sources on the final slide.

sourcing.chinese: Ma Jian, 马坚 (edition zh.jian), api.alquran.cloud
sourcing.korean: Edition ko.korean, api.alquran.cloud. Translator is listed as 'Unknown' in the source's own metadata, so the on-slide credit says the same rather than inventing a scholar's name. A trailing footnote marker ('[1])') present in the raw API response was stripped for display; the verse wording itself is unedited from the API response.
sourcing.japanese: Edition ja.japanese, api.alquran.cloud. Translator is listed as 'Unknown' in the source's own metadata, cited on-slide as such. An earlier query used an invalid edition id (ja.ryoichi) which the API silently dropped rather than erroring; the correct id was found via the /edition?language=ja endpoint.
sourcing.verification_note: All five language renderings came from api.alquran.cloud, a live Quran text and translation API, not from memory. See channels.json's ig-blankdiscussions._niche_note for why this project treats scripture sourcing as a hard requirement, not a style choice.

renderCommand: npx remotion still src/compositions/registry.tsx IslamicSlide out/blankdiscussions/2026-09-10/quran-94-5-slide-NN.png --props=daily/2026-09-10/blankdiscussions/quran-94-5.slide-NN.json  (run once per slide, NN = 01 through 07; note the entry point is src/compositions/registry.tsx, NOT src/index.ts which does not exist in this repo)
